name: copy-field
title: Copy field
description: A read-only value people copy rather than type, like a share link, a webhook URL or an API key. Copy turns into a drawn check and Copied only once the clipboard write succeeds, in a button that keeps its width so nothing moves. Secrets stay masked as their prefix, dots and the last four, with an eye to show them, and copying a hidden key still copies the real one.
